# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore - Overview — captured 2026-07-07

## Core Definition
Agentic platform for building, deploying, and operating agents securely at scale using any framework and foundation model, without infrastructure management.

## Core Services
| Service | Description | Key Integrations |
|---------|-------------|------------------|
| **Harness** | Managed agent loop: define & invoke an agent in one API call with model + system prompt + tools inline. Handles orchestration, tool execution, memory, response generation. Each session in an isolated microVM with filesystem + shell access. BYO container image supported. | Bedrock, OpenAI, Google Gemini, any OpenAI-compatible provider; Memory, Gateway, Browser, Code Interpreter, Observability; remote MCP servers, inline functions, custom containers |
| **Runtime** | Secure serverless runtime; fast cold starts, async, session isolation, built-in identity, multi-modal/multi-agent | CrewAI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Strands; MCP, A2A |
| **Memory** | Short-/long-term memory, cross-agent sharing | LangGraph, LangChain, Strands, LlamaIndex |
| **Gateway** | Converts APIs/Lambda/services into MCP tools; connect existing MCP servers | Salesforce, Zoom, JIRA, Slack, OpenAPI |
| **Identity** | Agent identity/access/auth, IdP-compatible | Cognito, Okta, Azure Entra ID, Auth0 |
| **Code Interpreter** | Isolated code-execution sandbox | Python, JavaScript, TypeScript |
| **Browser** | Cloud browser runtime for web interaction/form fill | Playwright, BrowserUse |
| **Observability** | Trace/debug/monitor via OpenTelemetry | OTEL, CloudWatch |
| **Payments** | Microtransactions for agents to access paid APIs/MCP servers/content via x402; wallet, spend limits, observability | Coinbase CDP, Stripe (Privy), x402 endpoints, Gateway, Strands |
| **Evaluations** | Automated agent assessment on sessions/traces/spans | Strands, LangGraph, OpenTelemetry, OpenInference, CloudWatch |
| **Optimization** | Continuous improvement: AI-generated recommendations, versioned config bundles, A/B testing to improve agents from traces. Optimizes system prompts + tool descriptions; traffic splitting via Gateway. | Builds on Evaluations; OTEL via Observability; Gateway for A/B traffic split |
| **Policy** | Deterministic control; NL or Cedar policy language; intercepts every tool call | Cedar, Gateway |
| **Registry** | Centralized catalog for agents, MCP servers, tools, skills, custom resources; governed publish/review/approve; hybrid search | Any MCP server/agent/skill/custom resource, AWS/on-prem/other cloud |

## Protocols
MCP, A2A, OpenTelemetry (OTEL), OpenInference, x402

## Supported Models
Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Amazon Nova, Meta Llama, Mistral

## Pricing
Consumption-based

All services present (Harness, Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Code Interpreter, Browser, Observability, Payments, Evaluations, Optimization, Policy, Registry) — same as prior cache.
